spec.name: Fabric shade sails over footway
spec.eligibleSite: Busiest pedestrian blocks in Oakland, Pittsburgh (candidate corridors: Forbes Ave and Fifth Ave; exact blocks to be confirmed)
openQuestions: Unit basis for unitCost: is capex per linear meter of footway shaded (assumed ~3 m sail coverage width)? Please confirm or provide local contractor quotes.
Which specific blocks are the 'busiest' (e.g., Forbes Ave between Bellefield Ave and Highland Ave, Fifth Ave near the Cathedral)? Block lengths set shaded_length_m.
Fabric specification (UPF rating, color, weave density) - denser/darker fabrics block more direct beam but may increase longwave re-radiation; confirm target solar_block_fraction.
Mounting approach: pole-mounted vs. building-mounted; pole spacing, foundations, and conflicts with utilities, signage, and street trees.
Structural loading for Pittsburgh wind and snow; required clear height over the footway and ADA clearance.
Maintenance responsibility, cleaning, and fabric replacement cycle (typically 10-15 years) to validate annualOpexUsd.
Winter removal vs. year-round installation preference.
